description: Hand-curated, manually-reviewable labelled examples for the semantic compliance classifier. Add rows here to fix mis-classifications; labels: COMPLIANT / PARTIAL / MISSING / UNKNOWN.

examples.requirement: A UPI provider must verify the customer identity (KYC) before allowing any merchant onboarding.
examples.response: We complete e-KYC for every merchant before they can accept UPI payments.
examples.label: COMPLIANT

examples.requirement: UPI participants must operate a complaint handling process with defined resolution timelines and escalation.
examples.response: Customers can raise complaints through our support portal, get a tracking ID, and unresolved cases are escalated to the grievance officer.
examples.label: COMPLIANT

examples.requirement: UPI participants must implement transaction monitoring and report unusual or suspicious activity.
examples.response: We do not monitor merchant transactions for suspicious patterns.
examples.label: MISSING

examples.requirement: UPI participants must maintain a grievance redressal mechanism.
examples.response: We plan to introduce a grievance mechanism next year.
examples.label: PARTIAL

examples.requirement: VDA service providers must apply AML/CFT screening and transaction monitoring.
examples.response: We support P2P crypto transfers without any KYC or AML checks.
examples.label: MISSING

examples.requirement: e-KYC must use Aadhaar OTP with explicit customer consent and a retention policy.
examples.response: We verify identity via Aadhaar OTP after capturing consent; records are purged at expiry.
examples.label: COMPLIANT

examples.requirement: Providers handling foreign exchange must maintain FEMA compliance and lodge periodic returns.
examples.response: We offer FX conversion without any RBI reporting or FEMA checks.
examples.label: MISSING

examples.requirement: Payment providers must report suspicious transactions to the regulator.
examples.response: Our marketing material discusses product pricing only.
examples.label: UNKNOWN

examples.requirement: NEFT/RTGS participants must verify customers before account activation.
examples.response: We open accounts without any identity verification step.
examples.label: MISSING

examples.requirement: NEFT/RTGS participants must verify customers before account activation.
examples.response: Verification is rolling out in Q3; until then we onboard directly.
examples.label: PARTIAL

examples.requirement: UPI providers must secure transactions with two-factor authentication.
examples.response: Every UPI debit requires OTP plus the 6-digit PIN.
examples.label: COMPLIANT

examples.requirement: AEPS participants must authenticate with Aadhaar and meet device standards.
examples.response: AEPS cash withdrawal uses Aadhaar authentication on certified devices.
examples.label: COMPLIANT
